name: Magewright's Cloak

effects.name: Charisma
effects.tooltip: Charisma +6 : This item makes the wearer have more flair, granting a +6 Enhancement bonus to Charisma.

effects.name: Stealth Strike
effects.tooltip: Stealth Strike : Reduces the threat generated by ranged attacks and spells by 15%.

effects.name: Perform
effects.tooltip: Perform +10 : Passive: +10 Competence bonus to the Perform skill.

effects.name: Enhanced Perform
effects.tooltip: Enhanced Perform +5 : Passive: +5 Enhancement bonus to the Perform skill.

effects.name: Nearly Finished - Magewright's Expertise
effects.tooltip: Magewright's Expertise : Spell Focus I: +1 to DCs for all spells. Magewright's Quick Wits : Chance to gain a 10 second buff of +12 Alchemical bonus to Universal Spell Power each time the wearer is hit by a physical attack.

flavor_text: A cloak often sported by House Cannith magewright. It enhances the wearer's natural flair and increases his or her ability to manipulate objects of magical origin.
